overlap.dialog_resolution: Retain incoming completed Mail dialog whole file. The temporary import/cast repair is superseded, not accidentally discarded.

The only engine production difference is a line-wrap/trailing-comma formatting change in automation/office_operations.dart, outside the previously audited Zotero import graph. Carry applicable standalone engine/editor execution forward; a broad rerun is not justified by this incoming delta.
validation_implications.studio: Four Mail core/store and eight Studio Mail production libraries change versus99a285c0 (one former picker is replaced in the workspace path by two new picker/string files). These are actual shared-workspace compilation/behavior dependencies. Rerun the existing four-file Studio Zotero/host-ownership cohort on the canonical final tree; its entrypoint files themselves are unchanged.

Two non-Zotero VBA test files also change formatting. No additional engine behavior or source import change was found in those patches.
